metadata.title: HOW TO ORGANIZE YOUR COIN COLLECTION - COIN TIPS
metadata.description:
Here are some coin tips of how to organize your coin collection. These are some great tips for those new to coin collecting. You can use coin books, coin holders, and even a coin collection app. Keep coin hunting and always remember you can find rare and silver coins without going to a coin dealer or coin shop and spending money!

summary.brief: The host shows how to sort and protect a coin collection using inexpensive holders and a phone app.
summary.detailed: The video opens with an animated “Couch Coins” logo. A young man in a red hoodie and blue baseball cap greets the audience and displays a large assortment of coins on his desk. He advises viewers to research their collection first, then recommends cheap $5 reference books, two‑by‑two cardboard holders and sleeves from eBay, and plastic rollers for common pennies, suggesting ways to sort by date, denomination or type. He pulls out his smartphone, opens a free coin‑collection app, scrolls through the digital inventory, and points out that the app lets you check which coins you own. He also mentions storing valuable pieces in a fire‑proof safe and teases a giveaway once the channel reaches 500 subscribers. The segment ends with a grey “Latest Video” screen showing green “LATEST VIDEO” text, a red “Subscribe” button, and decorative silver coins at the bottom.

action.detailed: Use the smartphone to scroll through the coin‑collection app while explaining sorting methods and protective storage options for the coins.

     manipulation, NOT just incidental hand movement (e.g. a vlog where
